test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sapna invested ₹22,500 on simple interest, partly at 7% per annum and partly at 5% per annum. If she earns equal interests from the two investments after 3 years, then find the sum invested at 7% per annum (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When **Interest** and **Time** are equal for two investments, the **Principal** ratio is inversely proportional to the **Rate** ratio.

Ratio of Investment (P₁ : P₂) = 1/R₁ : 1/R₂ = 1/7 : 1/5 = 5 : 7

Total units = 5 + 7 = 12 units → **₹22,500**

Sum at 7% (P₁) = (5 ÷ 12) × 22,500 = 5 × 1,875 = **₹9,375**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹9,375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total Sum = **₹22,500**, R₁ = **7%**, R₂ = **5%**, Time (T) = **3 years**.

**Formula Used:** Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a9e49f4a69e414fa36c972f3daeb035569e54b03e50aa1a4b40c6b17b4a34ae.png] 

Let the sum invested at 7% be **x** and the sum at 5% be **(22,500 − x)**.

⇒ SI₁ = (x × 7 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = ((22,500 − x) × 5 × 3) ÷ 100

Since SI₁ = SI₂:

⇒ (x × 7 × 3) ÷ 100 = ((22,500 − x) × 5 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 21x = 15 × (22,500 − x)

⇒ 21x = 3,37,500 − 15x

⇒ 36x = 3,37,500

⇒ x = 3,37,500 ÷ 36

⇒ x = 9,375

**∴ The correct answer is ₹9,375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Principal Ratio when Interests are Equal

If the interests earned on multiple sums are equal, the ratio of principals is P₁ : P₂ : ... : Pₙ = (1 / R₁T₁) : (1 / R₂T₂) : ... : (1 / RₙTₙ).

Principal Ratio when Amounts are Equal

If the final amounts (Principal + Interest) are equal, the ratio of principals is P₁ : P₂ = [100 / (100 + R₁T₁)] : [100 / (100 + R₂T₂)].

Effective Rate of Interest

The total interest earned on the entire sum can be found using the weighted average: Rₐvg = (P₁R₁ + P₂R₂) ÷ (P₁ + P₂).
